Seed train B (typical of train A)

Train B: typical of train A (P-201), same sizes, set points, interlocks and notes; stage 2 from the laboratory inoculates R-211B through a steamed sterile coupling (D-013, D-036). NaOH from T-215, P-215A/B and F-215 on P-201.

Not aerated (D-019): sterile N2 overlay through PCV-21x6B (restricted trim; 2.0 barg for stages 3, 4; 4.0 barg for stage 5), F-242B/244B/246B and PV-21x4B on PIC-21x4B; vents through F-241B/243B/245B (housing drains to traps). Rupture discs PSE-21x5B (D-036).

Steam blocks: two ball valves, steam fed and condensate bled between them, on every medium, base, inoculum and transfer connection (sterile boundary, D-020). CIP inlets: double-seat valves XV-21x9B with a steamed leakage chamber; sampling: steam-sterilisable aseptic sampling valves (D-036).

Fill batch stop: WIS-21x3B/LIS-2133B high-high closes XV-21x8B (C&E I-211 to I-213). Base: NaOH 10 wt% through the sterile filter F-215 to stages 3 and 4, milk of lime to stage 5 (D-013). Jackets on cooling water.
